name: YouYubeZ
description: Search and play YouTube in Zephyr TV. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to YouTube or Google. YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC. Uses youtubei.js (https://www.npmjs.com/package/youtubei.js), downloaded at install.

play.label: Play with
play.description: The TV's YouTube app, Zephyr TV's player, or both in the stream list.

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.description: Paste cookies from your YouTube browser session (the Cookie header, or a Netscape or JSON export). Needed for Subscriptions, Watch later and History. Zephyr TV checks them and refreshes the lists.

sections.label: Visible sections
sections.description: Video lists from keywords. Discover and Trending are already there: you can change them, remove them, or add more.
